text:
Anya: Heads up, deploy-bot is failing to promote canary to prod; cut window in 30m.
Anya: CI shows artifact extraction failures on multiple agents (symlink permissions).
Rik: Log excerpt: 
+ tar -xzf release.tgz
tar: scripts/bin -> ../bin: Cannot create symlink
ERROR: unpack failed
Rik: Also seeing artifact-index lease timeouts in deploy-bot logs.
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt 2 -> stalled. Reason: lease_acquire_timeout on artifact-indexer.
ops-jen: Oncall. Confirmed kernel auto-update on cache hosts this morning. Reverting during window risky (~20m).
ops-jen: Recommend manual pin to last-green sha to avoid missing SLA.
Anya: If we pin we need audit + release note explaining rationale. Who can run promote?
Rik: I can run manual promote and update release notes. Command: /deploy promote --image sha:1f2b3c --env prod --reason "pin-cache-symlink-unpack-failure"
qa-bot: If pinned, queue quick smoke (uploads, auth) once promoted. I'll run validations.
Rik: Executing manual promote now. /deploy promote --image sha:1f2b3c --env prod --reason "pin-cache-symlink-unpack-failure"
deploy-bot: Manual promotion requested by Rik. Rolling out to prod replicas.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. new prod image sha:1f2b3c. Health checks: OK.
qa-bot: Smoke runs queued, will report back in ~8m.
ops-jen: Opening infra ticket INFRA-2077 with logs and failing job ids bk/4411,bk/4415. Follow-up out of band.
Anya: Release note draft: "Pinned to sha:1f2b3c due to CI artifact extraction (symlink) failures after cache host kernel update; infra ticket INFRA-2077."
Rik: Adding exact promote command and decision rationale to docs.
Anya: Closing thread for cut; follow-ups tracked in INFRA-2077. Thanks team.
__notes: Slack thread as single continuous string; messages in chronological order and prefixed with sender name
